svg.title: More outages, more clusters
svg.desc: Two bars compare modelled annual probabilities. At a steady average of 19 independently arriving serious outages per year, 9.25 percent of years contain at least four outages within some rolling seven-day interval, about one year in eleven. At 37 per year, 60.05 percent of years do, about three years in five. Both bars use a zero to 100 percent scale. Each scenario uses two million simulated 365-day years. Illustration, not a forecast. Annual probability is not a fixed waiting time.
